# vMLX 1.6.71

vMLX 1.6.71 fixes the prefill throughput counter.

- Prefill tok/s now uses engine-measured model prefill and prompt-state preparation time, rather than uncached tokens divided by time to first token. Queueing, input preprocessing and cache restoration are excluded; TTFT stays separate.
- Preserve measured rates through local Chat Completions, Responses and tool continuations. Historical estimates and engines without a timing receipt do not display a fabricated rate.
- Retains the SSD prefix/refault fixes from 1.6.70. No speculative-decoding or kernel defaults changed.

Validated with connected Qwen 27B reasoning, tools, image/video, history and SSD reuse, plus GLM JANGH native reasoning efforts and raw Chat tool/media continuations.

Known limitation: video perception remains imperfect. Qwen Flash-Next and GLM JANGH can describe nonexistent overlapping/transition text; a GLM Max-effort UI video turn repeated that interpretation and was stopped. Correct tool-derived arithmetic does not establish exact video understanding. This update does not resolve those model-quality failures.

Downloads: Tahoe uses native macOS 26 wheels; Sequoia is the compatibility build for macOS 14.5 and later.
